packet_name: Six prospective controls for reviewer refutation-prompt comparison
scope: A small prospective control packet, distinct from the familiar six-case historical batch. Five cases are newly designed and one required bus case is explicitly a familiar positive derivative. This is not a random sample or a full-pipeline qualification.
model_input_boundary: Only each item and its explicitly synthetic_independent_solution are eligible to enter model inputs. Gold, provenance notes, counterexamples, supported-choice sets, pair labels, novelty labels and evaluator checks are evaluator-only. Both prompt arms must receive identical question and fixture bytes.
synthetic_context_policy: These reviewer-shaped solver fixtures were authored by the evaluator. They are not actual model outputs, independent confirmation, or a production solver measurement. Each fixture deliberately has one claimed supported answer and three claimed refutations, matching the tested review interface. Gold depends only on the unchanged question and actual facts, never on those fallible declarations.

prospective_content_criteria.bad_cases: Both defective cases must be rejected with exact identity. Negative disposition does not reveal a defect-specific rationale.
prospective_content_criteria.valid_cases: All four valid cases retained with exact keys and sound main/all-choice feedback. Do not reject the minimum-bus derivative merely because the26-ride option also satisfies the weaker inequality.
prospective_content_criteria.feedback: Every final explanation must be independently sound, bounded and shuffle-safe. Arithmetic or causal claims copied from false synthetic reasons fail.
prospective_content_criteria.uncertainty: Any material uncertainty counts as failure; no after-output reinterpretation of gold.
prospective_content_criteria.difficulty: Assess independently and report separately from exact-key/content correctness; do not give semantic rejection credit for excluding an item by a difficulty floor.
prospective_content_criteria.limits: These criteria supplement the parent-frozen operational plan. This packet alone does not authorize provider calls.
